Inventive take on traditional Vietnamese food
May 2024 • Couples
Stumbled into this fantastic vegan and vegetarian restaurant in District 1 in Ho Chi Min City tonight out of the sweltering Sout East Asian heat wave to a really cool scene with a truely exciting inventive take on traditional Vietnamese food. Apart from the food the vibe was inspiring with stylish lo-fi renovation utilising found and recycled materials, super friendly staff with the chef taking time to come to the table and explain which sauces go with what and how the broth was cured. The clientele felt like an international vegan/vego fellowship with Vietnamese, Chinese, Australian and French all nodding approvingly and exchanging glances after every dish. But you don’t have to be V to enjoy this scene - we’re all living in this one world and sharing good taste and great flavours is just the beginning of the next revolution. Get on board next time you’re in HCMC at Rau Oi Zero Meatz Cusine. We’re going back tomorrow! 🇻🇳 ☮️ ❤️
